Service 01 • Logistics & Trade

Transport and Export in Jharkhand & West Bengal

Safe, reliable goods transportation, heavy freight logistics, and specialized export support linking Jharkhand's industrial zones to West Bengal ports and global destinations.

On-Time & Safe Delivery

Comprehensive Freight Movement & Export Guidance

Transporting goods across state lines and facilitating export clearances can be complex. GB Group provides end-to-end transport and export solutions, managing fleet movement, transit safety, documentation, and port coordination under one reliable roof.

Verified Fleets: GPS-tracked trucks, trailers, and multi-axle freight carriers.
Port Access: Direct handling and coordination at Kolkata and Haldia ports.
01

What Is Transported

We handle diverse cargo categories tailored to manufacturers, traders, and suppliers:

  • Industrial & Steel Cargo: TMT bars, structural steel, fabrication materials, machinery, and equipment.
  • Raw Materials & Minerals: Minerals, ores, cement, coal by-products, and building materials.
  • Manufactured & Commercial Goods: FMCG products, consumer goods, retail merchandise, and packaged items.
  • Containerized Freight: Standard 20ft and 40ft shipping containers for domestic transit and port export.
  • Agricultural & Perishable Commodities: Grains, produce, and bulk farm output requiring timely delivery.
02

Where The Service Reaches

Extensive coverage spanning Jharkhand, West Bengal, and connecting eastern corridors:

  • Jharkhand Core Corridors: Ranchi, Jamshedpur (Adityapur industrial belt), Bokaro Steel City, Dhanbad, Ramgarh, and Giridih.
  • West Bengal Hubs: Kolkata metropolitan area, Howrah freight complexes, Hooghly, Durgapur, Asansol, and Siliguri.
  • Port Gateways: Kolkata Port (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port) and Haldia Dock Complex.
  • Interstate Links: Seamless transit between Jharkhand, West Bengal, Bihar, Odisha, and Northeast transit points.
03

What Help Is Given With Export

Navigating export hurdles smoothly with dedicated documentation and port clearance support:

  • Export Documentation Guidance: Invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and e-way bills prepared accurately.
  • Customs & Port Coordination: Liaison with customs clearing agents, port authorities, and terminal operators.
  • Container Yard (CY) & Port Delivery: Coordinating container movement right up to the vessel dock or ICD.
  • Transit Insurance Support: Helping safeguard your high-value cargo against damage or loss in transit.
  • Real-Time Transit Tracking: Regular updates from loading point until final destination delivery.

Safe and On-Time Delivery Guarantee

At GB Group, punctuality and cargo security are our highest priorities. Our dedicated dispatchers and on-ground supervisors ensure smooth transit without unnecessary delays or hidden charges.
